$comment: Hand edits to the drop tables, applied by NpcDrops.plugin.js on top of the Wiki dump (npc-drops.json and npc-drop-subtables.json, generated by osrsreboxed-db's `python -m scripts.drops.update`). Keep them here, never in the generated files, so a new dump can't undo them. See docs/npc-drops.md.

removeNpcs.6594: Ent: its loot comes from the Ent trunk it leaves (Woodcutting Guild, plugins/skills/woodcutting).
removeNpcs.6406: Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup's tribesman (hiding form): it drops nothing.
removeNpcs.6407: Tai Bwo Wannai Cleanup's tribesman: only bones (Wiki, and every recorded kill), dropped by plugins/minigames/taibwowannaicleanup/Events.

addNpcs.$comment: NPC ids the dumper doesn't map to their table: variants and versions it misses (added 2026-09-15, 'import missing NPC tables with corrected variant mappings'). An NPC the dump already maps gets the tables it lacks appended, in the order listed, so the dump's own first table stays the default (the zombie pirates' Medium Wilderness Diary table).

addTables.$comment: Whole tables the dumper does not export, in the dump's own shape, transcribed from the Wiki page named in wiki_page. A table the dump has by the same id wins. Black dragon: the page's 'Wilderness Slayer Cave' dropversion (ids 7861-7863, the level 247 dragons), read 18 November 2026; the dump holds only the Regular one. The page's Monkey Madness II alternative for the javelin tips (10 rune knives) is not a row: no plugin answers that quest for drops yet, as on the Regular table.

black_dragon_wilderness_slayer_cave.label: Wilderness Slayer Cave drops
black_dragon_wilderness_slayer_cave.table_name: Black dragon Wilderness Slayer Cave drops

entries.name: Dragon javelin tips
notes: Only dropped after completion of Monkey Madness II. If players have not completed the quest, they will receive 10 rune knives instead.

tertiary.name: Clue scroll (hard)
notes: The hard clue scroll rarity changes to 1/64 if a Ring of wealth (i) is worn.
Clue scrolls will drop as scroll boxes after the completion of X Marks the Spot.

tertiary.name: Clue scroll (elite)
notes: The elite clue scroll rarity changes to 1/250 if a Ring of wealth (i) is worn.
Clue scrolls will drop as scroll boxes after the completion of X Marks the Spot.

replaceNpcTables.$comment: NPC ids the dump maps to the wrong table of their page: `from` is what the dump gives them (the override applies only while it still does), `tables` what they roll.

bossNpcs.$comment: Bosses the cache does not mark with param 1361, so NpcDrops' boss rare multiplier would skip them. Yama is not in monsters-complete yet and its NPC carries no params; Araxxor and the Shellbane gryphon are Wiki bosses whose cache rows omit the param. Remove an id once the cache (or the dump) marks it.

addTertiary.name: Abyssal orphan
notes: 1/2,560 per Abyssal Sire kill; 5/128 when using an unsired on the Font of Consumption.

abyssal_sire.why: The Abyssal orphan pet, which the dump leaves out (activity pets, 2026-10-04).

yama.why: The Wiki page's Contract section lists what each of Yama's contracts rewards; a normal kill drops none of it (Wiki: Yama, Contracts).
